FAR AI

https://www.longtermwiki.com/wiki/E138

EU AI Office tender EC-CNECT/2025/OP/0032, Lot 1 led by FAR.AI with SecureBio and SaferAI; FY2024 revenue. Cited from a search snippet; not re-fetched in full. [verify 2026-09-15 grok-pass] Loads. Coefficient components ~$28.675M, $6.65M, $2.16M, $1.7M + $12M regrant; FY2024 rev $24.3M; dev-revenue cap 10%; 2025 commitments >$30M. Tier-2 lead for T03 components, not a filing.

Signals citing this source

  • EU AI Office, S (for): Contracts its own evaluators (FAR.AI-led consortium) rather than relying on lab-chosen ones.“FAR AI was selected by the European Commission's AI Office to lead CBRN risk research under tender EC-CNECT/2025/OP/0032”
  • FAR.AI, S (for): Selected by the European Commission to lead a three-year CBRN technical-assistance contract, with a regulator as client.“FAR AI was selected by the European Commission's AI Office to lead Lot 1 (CBRN Risk Modelling and Evaluation)”
  • FAR.AI, A (for): Pre- and post-deployment red teaming for labs and EU bodies.“FAR AI began red-teaming leading language models for frontier labs in Q4 2023, including red-teaming of GPT-4”
  • FAR.AI, P (against): Runs field-building programs that place researchers into labs.
  • FAR.AI, X (for): No commercial products; consulting limited to governments.“FAR AI conducts empirical technical AI safety research without developing or deploying AI products of its own”
  • SaferAI, S (for): Part of the EU AI Office evaluation consortium; sets its own rating methodology.
  • SecureBio, S (for): Evaluates models from many developers; consortium member on the EU AI Office CBRN contract.“FAR AI leads a consortium including SecureBio”
